newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: MAXTEL ACQUIRES AUDIO PRODUCTION FIRM.
newsitem.headline: MAXTEL ACQUIRES AUDIO PRODUCTION FIRM.

text.p: Telecommunications group Maxtel Ltd said on Wednesday agreement had been reached on the acquisition of audio production and duplication firm QED Productions for 750.000 rand, effective from April 9.
Maxtel said the acquisition was in line with its aim to diversify into the media sector to take advantage of the convergence of broadcasting, information technology and telecommunications.
The group last issued a cautionary on August 1.
